web.nav_hidden	Menu keys hidden from the web navigation (Today and Settings are always shown)
work.draft.min_prompts	Which human prompt of a session creates a work-item draft (1 = the first one)
work.draft.exclude_projects	Project keys that get no draft (exact match)
work.draft.exclude_cwds	Directories that get no draft (a session whose cwd starts with any entry matches)
work.draft.exclude_title_patterns	Title regexes that get no draft (a session whose title matches any of them is skipped)
work.short_session.max_minutes	Duration threshold of a short-lived session, in minutes (an ended session that lived shorter than this and had fewer prompts than the prompt threshold is left out of the summarizer and the steward)
work.short_session.max_prompts	Prompt-count threshold of a short-lived session (a session with fewer human prompts than this that also lived briefly is left out of the summarizer and the steward)
prompt.steward.role	Full replacement of the steward role prompt (empty = the built-in default)
prompt.steward.role.extra	Extra requirements appended after the steward role prompt (the recommended way to state preferences; it keeps up with default prompt updates)
prompt.steward.review	Full replacement of the steward review prompt (empty = the built-in default)
prompt.steward.review.extra	Extra requirements appended after the steward review prompt
prompt.work.summarizer	Full replacement of the summarizer prompt (empty = the built-in default; the required JSON output format is always appended by the code and cannot be replaced)
prompt.work.summarizer.extra	Extra requirements appended after the summarizer prompt (the recommended way to adjust it)
